_what: How a Chromium is made to start on a Linux computer where nothing may be installed system-wide (the Cloudflare build: Ubuntu 24.04, no root, no browser libraries; read by bare-linux.mjs). The browser is Playwright's own `browser` build. The libraries it lacks are the packages Playwright itself names for this distribution (`playwright install-deps --dry-run`), plus any library one of them still lacks, each fetched as a package file from the distribution's archive and unpacked into `folder` beside the checkout, never installed. Pictures compare only when every run draws the same letters, so the fonts are pinned too: only the `fonts.packages`, unpacked the same way, are visible to the browser, and each generic family a page may name is drawn with the face in `fonts.families`. `folder` is relative to the checkout's git folder. install names the deduplicated Playwright distribution bundles needed by every launch mode; chromium includes both full Chromium (extension/channel guards) and its default headless shell.
